H3873.name: Hallohesh
H3873.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3873.brief: Father of Shallum, a leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
H3873.short: Hallohesh was the father of Shallum, a leader who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H3837A.name: Laban
H3837A.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3837A.brief: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel
H3837A.short: Laban, the brother of Rebekah and father of Jacob's wives, Leah and Rachel.

H3815.name: Lael
H3815.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3815.brief: Father of Eliasaph, a Gershonite Levite
H3815.short: Lael, the father of Eliasaph, a leader of the Gershonite Levites.

H3855.name: Lahad
H3855.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3855.short: Lahad, a descendant of Judah through Jahath.

H3889.name: Laish
H3889.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3889.short: Laish, the father of Palti (or 'Paltiel'), to whom Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage.

H3812.name: Leah
H3812.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3812.brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah
H3812.short: Leah, the first wife of Jacob and mother of six of his sons and his daughter Dinah.

H3838.name: Lebanah
H3838.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3838.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile
H3838.short: Lebanah or Lebana, whose descendants were among the temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H3853.name: Lehabim
H3853.brief: Son of Mizraim; progenitor of a people group
H3853.short: Lehabim, a son of Mizraim and progenitor of a people group.

H3817.name: Leummim
H3817.brief: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah
H3817.short: Leummim, a son of Dedan and descendant of Abraham and Keturah.

H3878.name: Levi
H3878.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3878.brief: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites
H3878.short: Levi, son of Jacob and Leah, was the progenitor of the Levites, the priestly tribe of Israel.

H3845H.name: Libni
H3845H.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3845H.brief: Grandson of Merari; grandson of Levi
H3845H.short: Libni, a grandson of Merari and grandson of Levi.

H3845G.name: Libni
H3845G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3845G.brief: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi
H3845G.short: Libni or Ladan, a son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

H3818.name: Lo-ammi
H3818.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3818.brief: Symbolic name of Hosea's son; represents God's rejection of Israel
H3818.short: Lo-ammi, meaning "not my people," was the symbolic name given to Hosea's son, representing God's rejection of Israel.

H3819.name: Lo-ruhamah
H3819.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3819.brief: Symbolic name of Hosea's daughter; represents God's withdrawal of mercy
H3819.short: Lo-ruhamah, meaning "not pitied," was the symbolic name given to Hosea's daughter, representing God's withdrawal of mercy from Israel.

H3876G.name: Lot
H3876G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3876G.brief: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction
H3876G.short: Lot, the nephew of Abraham, was rescued from Sodom before its destruction.

H3877.name: Lotan
H3877.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3877.brief: Son of Seir the Horite; chief of Edom
H3877.short: Lotan, a son of Seir the Horite and a chief of Edom.

H3865.name: Lud
H3865.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3865.brief: Son of Shem; progenitor of the Lydians
H3865.short: Lud, a son of Shem and progenitor of the Lydians.

H3866G.name: Ludim
H3866G.brief: Son of Mizraim; progenitor of a people group
H3866G.short: Ludim, a son of Mizraim and progenitor of a people group.

H3837B.name: Laban
H3837B.brief: A place Moses spoke to Israel
H3837B.short: Laban, a place where Moses spoke to the Israelites (<ref="Deu.1.1">Deu.1.1</ref>).

H3844G.name: Lebanon
H3844G.brief: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees
H3844G.short: Lebanon, a mountainous region north of Israel, known for its cedar trees and as a symbol of strength and beauty (<ref="1Ki.4.33; Psalm 92:12">1Ki.4.33; Psalm 92:12</ref>).

H3844H.name: Lebanon Mount
H3844H.brief: A mountain range marking the northern border of Israel
H3844H.short: Mount Lebanon, a mountain range marking the northern border of the Promised Land (<ref="Judges 3:3">Judges 3:3</ref>).

H3844I.name: Lebanon Valley
H3844I.brief: A valley in the Promised Land conquered by Joshua
H3844I.short: The Valley of Lebanon, a valley in the Promised Land conquered by Joshua (<ref="Joshua 11:17; 12:7">Joshua 11:17; 12:7</ref>).

H3822.name: Lebaoth
H3822.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H3822.short: Lebaoth, a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:32">Joshua 15:32</ref>).

H3829.name: Lebonah
H3829.brief: A place near Shiloh in Ephraim
H3829.short: Lebonah, a place near Shiloh in the territory of Ephraim (<ref="Judges 21:19">Judges 21:19</ref>).

H3896.name: Lehi
H3896.brief: A place where Samson fought the Philistines
H3896.short: Lehi, a place where Samson fought against the Philistines and God provided him with water (<ref="Judges 15:9, 14, 19">Judges 15:9, 14, 19</ref>).

H3841H.name: Libnah
H3841H.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city
H3841H.short: Libnah, a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua (<ref="Joshua 10:29-30">Joshua 10:29-30</ref>) and later designated as a Levitical city (<ref="Joshua 21:13">Joshua 21:13</ref>).

H3841G.name: Libnah
H3841G.brief: A place where Israel camped in the wilderness
H3841G.short: Libnah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey (<ref="Numbers 33:20-21">Numbers 33:20-21</ref>).

H3864.name: Libya
H3864.short: Libya (Put or Pul), a country in North Africa mentioned in various Old Testament prophecies (<ref="Ezk.30.5; 38:5; Nam.3.9">Ezk.30.5; 38:5; Nam.3.9</ref>).

H3850.name: Lod
H3850.brief: A city in Benjamin; home of Aeneas healed by Peter
H3850.short: Lod (Lydda), a city in the territory of Benjamin (<ref="1Ch.8.12">1Ch.8.12</ref>), where Peter healed Aeneas <ref="(Act.9.32-35">(Act.9.32-35</ref>).

H3810.name: Lo-debar
H3810.brief: A town in Gilead; home of Mephibosheth
H3810.short: Lo-debar (Debir), a town in Gilead where Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son, lived (<ref="2Sa.9.4-5">2Sa.9.4-5</ref>).

H3872.name: Luhith
H3872.short: Luhith, a place in Moab mentioned in prophecies of Isaiah and Jeremiah (<ref="Isaiah 15:5; Jeremiah 48:5">Isaiah 15:5; Jeremiah 48:5</ref>).

H3870G.name: Luz
H3870G.brief: A Canaanite city; a man built another city named Luz
H3870G.short: Luz, a Canaanite city that was destroyed, and another city built by a man who had betrayed the first Luz (<ref="Judges 1:26">Judges 1:26</ref>).

H3882.name: Leviathan
H3882.brief: A large sea creature mentioned in the Bible
H3882.short: Leviathan is a large sea creature mentioned in several Old Testament passages, often associated with chaos, evil, or God's power over creation (<ref="Job.3.8; 41:1; Psalm 74:14; 104:26; Isaiah 27:1">Job.3.8; 41:1; Psalm 74:14; 104:26; Isaiah 27:1</ref>).
